limitations: Native independent analytic 2D skeletal character, armor plates, sword history, additive procedural flames, particles, ground rings/cracks, sun/torii/mountain environment and move labels. Zero reference images/movie playback.
Original body rig, contour, choreography, flame simulation and exact font were not recovered. Explicit pose keyframes and deterministic analytic particles approximate observed actions.
Original is variable-rate; independent export is fixed 30 fps. Windows SimSun is a system font dependency; OFL Geist is bundled.

portable_demo.textures: Original replaceable schematic assets; not the original reference artwork.
portable_demo.approval: Historical motion implementation; this portable demo is not user-approved.
